{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.74

|gr1= GUI Control - Tree View

|arg= local

|eff= local

|descr= Expands tree item pointed to by the path. IDC means id of parent Tree View.

|s1= [[tvExpand]] [idc, path]

|p1= idc: [[Number]]

|p2= path: [[Tree View Path]] - [] will expand the whole tree if it was collapsed previously with []

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= control [[tvExpand]] path

|p21= control: [[Control]]

|p22= path: [[Tree View Path]] - [] will expand the whole tree if it was collapsed previously with []

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>tvExpand [101, [0]];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_ctrl tvExpand [1];</sqf>
